title: PRE-RAID: PACK WHEEL ITEMS, AMMO, KEYS AND A DATA CORE ON THE MAP SELECT SCREEN
why: His order (2026-10-15): "On the pre-raid screen (the map select screen, renamed PRE-RAID), quickly pick how much cash and how many of each wheel item to take, plus keys and guns. Also how much ammo to take. Slot a data core there too." The map select screen is now headed PRE-RAID and has a PACK row: a chip per kind of carryable item in the stash with minus, plus and MAX, ALL and NONE, and a data core slot. First slice: cash is not in yet because a raid has no cash to carry in.
now: The map select screen is now PRE-RAID, with a PACK row: plus, minus and MAX for each wheel item, ammo, key and gun, and a data core slot.
